assessment.description: Sanitized regression fixture; not evidence of a live agent evaluation.

product.name: Example Records
product.overview: A small tool for reviewing and updating observation records.
users: A person maintaining a collection of observation records.

application.summary: One activity area supports record review and correction.

shell.description: A window with persistent navigation and one active workspace.

navigation.description: The current collection remains available while one record is edited.

features.name: Record maintenance
features.purpose: Inspect one record and preserve a corrected value.

useCases.name: Update a record
useCases.trigger: The user chooses a record from the collection.
preconditions: At least one record is available.

steps.action: Open the selected record for editing.
steps.response: The selected record becomes editable without losing collection context.
Progress and then the saved result appear in the workspace.

useCases.outcome: The corrected record remains visible as saved.

alternatives.response: The edited value remains visible with a failure result.
alternatives.recovery: The user can retry without re-entering the value.

surfaces.name: Records workspace
surfaces.purpose: Review the collection and update one current record.
surfaces.entry: Open the collection or return from another activity area.
surfaces.exit: Leave after saved work or an explicit discard decision.
surfaces.focusIntent: Begin at the current record or the first available record.

regions.name: Record collection
regions.purpose: Show the available records and current selection.

regions.name: Record details
regions.purpose: Show the editable value and save result.

components.name: Record list
components.purpose: Identify and select an available record.
capabilities: Show record identity and current selection.
behaviorRequirements: Selection remains visible when the record opens.

components.name: Record field
components.purpose: Show and edit the current observation value.
capabilities: Display and edit the current value.
behaviorRequirements: A failed save preserves the edited value.

components.name: Save status
components.purpose: Communicate save progress, completion, or failure.
capabilities: Show saving, saved, and failed outcomes.
behaviorRequirements: Failure identifies the retained edit and available recovery.

actions.name: Open record
actions.purpose: Move from collection review into editing the selected record.
actions.outcome: The selected record is editable while collection context remains visible.

alternateInputs.description: Activate the focused record entry with the platform activation key.

cancellation.description: Opening the record is an immediate navigation action.

patternBasis.rationale: Opening a selected list item is a familiar application interaction.

actions.name: Save record
actions.outcome: The workspace identifies the corrected record as saved or preserves it for retry.

alternateInputs.description: Activate the focused save command with the platform activation key.

feedback.description: The workspace identifies that saving is in progress.
The workspace identifies the current value as saved.
The workspace identifies failure while preserving the edited value.

cancellation.description: The bounded save is allowed to finish; failure preserves the edit for retry.

recovery.response: Keep the edited value and offer retry in the failed state.

patternBasis.rationale: A named save command with progress and retryable failure is a familiar form workflow.

actions.name: Retry save
actions.purpose: Repeat the failed save with the preserved value.
actions.outcome: The preserved correction enters the save flow again.

canonicalInteraction.description: Activate the retry command presented with save failure.

alternateInputs.description: Activate the focused retry command with the platform activation key.

conditions: The current edited value has a failed save result.

feedback.description: The workspace returns to saving feedback.

cancellation.description: Retry starts the same bounded save operation.

patternBasis.rationale: A retry command adjacent to a recoverable failure is a familiar recovery interaction.

interactionFrames.name: Records viewing
interactionFrames.purpose: Show collection context and the primary entry into record editing.

patternBasis.rationale: A selectable collection beside current details is a familiar review pattern.

regions.name: Collection
regions.purpose: Orient the user and expose available records.

content.text: Available records and the current selection.
content.purpose: Provide the information needed to choose a record.

focus.entry: Place focus on the current record or the first available record.

interactionFrames.name: Record editing
interactionFrames.purpose: Keep the current value and primary save action together.

patternBasis.rationale: Editing a bounded value with one primary save action is a familiar form pattern.

regions.name: Record details
regions.purpose: Present the editable value before the save command.

focus.entry: Place focus on the editable value.

interactionFrames.name: Record saving
interactionFrames.purpose: Keep the edited value visible while save progress is communicated.

patternBasis.rationale: Visible in-progress feedback is a familiar asynchronous form state.

regions.name: Saving progress
regions.purpose: Preserve task context while the save is active.

content.purpose: Confirm that the save action is active.

focus.entry: Keep focus in the record details while saving is active.

interactionFrames.name: Record saved
interactionFrames.purpose: Confirm completion while keeping the corrected record visible.

patternBasis.rationale: Visible completion feedback in the owning form is a familiar result state.

regions.name: Saved result
regions.purpose: Show the corrected value and completed outcome.

focus.entry: Keep focus with the corrected record after completion.

interactionFrames.name: Record save failed
interactionFrames.purpose: Preserve the edit, explain failure, and expose one contextual recovery action.

patternBasis.rationale: Inline failure feedback with a retry action is a familiar recoverable form state.

regions.name: Preserved edit and recovery
regions.purpose: Keep the edited value visible and offer retry.

content.text: The record was not saved; the edited value remains available.
content.purpose: Explain the result and preserved work.

focus.entry: Keep focus with the failed save result and its recovery action.

pruningReview.summary: The primary task has one canonical path; retry appears only in the state that needs it.

decisions.candidate: The record-open and save actions in the canonical task path.
decisions.rationale: Each action advances a distinct required step toward the saved outcome.
decisions.result: The canonical path contains one visible action for each required step.

decisions.candidate: A persistent retry command before any failure occurs.
decisions.rationale: Retry has meaning only after a failed save.
decisions.result: Retry appears only in the failed state.
